mission: Mission 3DA - PopSign fresh5 revised scratch architecture/input scaffold

head.subject: observer: CONTINUE - popsign fresh5 scaffold handoff

changed_files.change_summary: Registers scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1, binds popsign_fresh5_rgb_regions_plus_derived_motion_tokens_v1, adds a no-pretrained motion-region token temporal classifier scaffold with forward_with_diagnostics, and leaves the old scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 class path intact.

source_supported_observations.observation: Mission 3DA authorizes one local/no-spend, no-training scaffold slice and allows compile/import, no-grad shape smoke, deterministic fixture forward pass, parameter count, and diagnostic key presence checks.

M3CZ bound architecture_id scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1 and input_contract_id popsign_fresh5_rgb_regions_plus_derived_motion_tokens_v1, with existing rgb_regions as B,16,5,3,96,96 after preparation and on-the-fly derived motion as B,16,5,9,96,96.

M3CZ required time-region tokens to persist through temporal and cross-region interaction before final pooling, no pretrained dependencies, no tensor regeneration, fail-closed browser claims, parameter count at or below 3000000 unless later human scope approval changes the budget, and representation diagnostic outputs before fitting.
The scaffold registers scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1 in ALLOWED_MODEL_ARCHITECTURES and build_model.
The scaffold derives signed and absolute adjacent-frame RGB deltas on the fly when input has 3 RGB channels, accepts already-derived 9-channel input, and does not write tensors or manifests.
The old scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 class and build_model branch remain present and were not edited.
web/public/model/model-card.json remains status not_trained, and docs/model/active-vocabulary-claim.json remains modelVersion rawframe-not-trained with activeLabels [] and evidenceArtifacts [].

reviewer_inference: This is a scaffold and shape/diagnostic proof only; it does not show that the revised architecture can learn PopSign fresh5.

The next useful slice is a no-training fit-readiness review because the scaffold now instantiates and passes B=1/B=2 no-grad checks, but training remains unauthorized until a separate prompt reviews whether one bounded local fit is justified.
The parameter and retained-diagnostic byte counts fit the M3CZ first-scaffold budget, but browser runtime/export parity is not proven and remains outside this slice.

old_path_compatibility.notes: The old class and build_model branch were left intact; no-grad instantiation and forward pass still return B,5 logits.

decision.rationale: The scaffold now registers and instantiates the M3CZ architecture/input contract, passes no-grad B=1/B=2 shape and diagnostic-key checks, fits the parameter and retained-diagnostic budget gates, preserves old-path instantiation/forward behavior, and keeps browser claims fail-closed. The next useful slice is therefore a no-training readiness review for whether one bounded local fit can be authorized under a later prompt, not fitting in M3DA.
